addedWinners.title: Contingency Contract: Indigo Experimental Operation
addedWinners.summary: Challenge and mission reward window starts November 5 at 12:00 server time; content updates November 12 at 12:00 server time. Ends before the next version update and maintenance, with no announced calendar cutoff. The separate Secret Sanctuary exchange has its own December 2 cutoff. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

addedWinners.title: Echoes of War: Season of Fervor
addedWinners.summary: Seasonal reward window starts November 5 at 12:00 server time and ends before the next version update and maintenance; closing date and time are unannounced. The permanent Echoes of War mode remains available. No cycle deadlines are inferred; opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

addedWinners.title: Secret Sanctuary
addedWinners.summary: Exchange earned Vitrified Indigo for event rewards from November 5 at 12:00 through December 2 at 04:00 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC-5). This exchange deadline is separate from the Contingency Contract challenge period and does not establish its end. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

addedWinners.title: The Stars Are With Me
addedWinners.summary: Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn The Stars Are With Me HH Permit x5. Starts November 5 at 12:00 server time; ends before the next version update and maintenance, with no announced calendar cutoff. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

addedWinners.title: Sanity Supply — November 2026
addedWinners.summary: Complete daily missions for Sanity Supply rewards. Starts November 18 at 04:00 server time; Asia ends November 25 at 04:00 (UTC+8), while Americas/Europe ends November 24 at 17:00 (UTC-5). Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions; the western closing clock is an explicit exception.
